source.title: Dynamics of Third-Order Rational Difference Equations with Open Problems and Conjectures

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as a single zbMATH resolver URL. A local shard row for the same zbMATH identifier supplied the exact title and year, but not a readable primary artifact or full-text link.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. The direct zbMATH URL returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge in local fetches, and page-reading did not expose readable record text, metadata, PDF links, or full-text links. zbMATH REST/OAI recovery attempts were blocked by DNS/network issues or exposed only API terms/documentation rather than a readable document record.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact ISBNs 9781584887652 and 9781584887669 plus PDF, and the Internet Archive identifier dynamicsthirdord00camo. Candidate pages were rejected because ResearchGate was blocked locally and only search snippets were visible; OpenLibrary exposed bibliographic metadata and download labels but no readable source body, while the linked Internet Archive details/download endpoints returned missing or forbidden artifacts; Routledge, Adlibris, LIBRIS, and similar pages were publisher, library, or sales metadata without the problem statements; Scribd and ebook-mirror candidates were not accepted as source-authorized exact-work artifacts.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact containing the book's problem statements was recovered. The source-adequacy gate forbids extraction from zbMATH metadata, OpenLibrary metadata, publisher/store descriptions, search snippets, blocked pages, or non-source-authorized mirrors.

Rejected extraction because the run had no primary source artifact with locatable verbatim problem-statement evidence. Accepted items must have page-number or stable-locator evidence from the chosen source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5191508.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
